meta.title: Call of Duty Sensitivity Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert sensitivity from any game to Call of Duty. Accurate cm/360 calculation.
sensConverterDesc: Enter your sensitivity and DPI — conversion updates automatically.
cm360Desc: Distance your mouse must travel for one full 360° rotation
steps_cod-sensitivity-converter_1: Enter your Call of Duty sensitivity
steps_cod-sensitivity-converter_1Desc: Input your CoD mouse sensitivity. Found in Settings → Controller/Mouse → Mouse Sensitivity. Note your ADS sensitivity multiplier as well.
steps_cod-sensitivity-converter_2Desc: Choose the destination game. CoD's fast time-to-kill means precise aim matters less than in tactical shooters — converted sensitivity may feel slightly different.
steps_cod-sensitivity-converter_3Desc: Apply the converted value. Play a few matches in casual mode to adjust before taking it into ranked or competitive play.
desc: Convert sensitivity from any game to Call of Duty. Accurate cm/360 calculation.
